references.label: Captive balls
references.description: Use the eject hole to open the right gate and spot KORA. Hit three different captive balls for 30K, 40K, and 50K, reset them at the upper-left chamber, and carry a large bonus at 5x.

references.label: top lanes
references.description: Feed the top lanes through the eject hole or an open right gate.

references.label: Reset ball chamber
references.description: Shoot the upper-left reset ball chamber to return the hit captive balls to reachable positions. Their raised value remains.
